The meeting is Europe’s largest healthcare-dedicated financial conference, attracting an estimated 800 global public and private companies across the life sciences. During the meeting, Ms. Ricciardi will discuss the company’s recent FDA meeting to finalize the selection of endpoints for the planned Phase 3 study of zervimesine in dementia with Lewy bodies (DLB).
